# CCI LONELY PLANET GAP-CHECK — INDIA8 INTEGRATION

Date: 2026-08-23
Source: CCI result on PR #23, commit `b32c374debe887715bf9b67808c058d482be0f01`, branch `claude/werk-je-nu-of-niet-oa10y7`.

## Verdict
Existing two discovery sweeps are strong: 26 North + 54 Ganges/South findings. CCI high-threshold independent check found only 3 evident misses.

## ADDITIVE MISSES

### LP-GAP-01 — Ganga Aarti, Har Ki Pauri, Haridwar
- cluster: Haridwar/Kankhal/Rishikesh B/reserve
- type: iconic public ritual / cultural experience
- importance: strong additive cluster weight; no detour if Haridwar is included
- effect on cluster: raises B-pressure but does NOT automatically promote cluster to A; combine with Rishikesh atmosphere, rafting if wanted, and Kankhal site-A.
- Mark decision: not yet separately graded in this integration.

### LP-GAP-02 — ISKCON Krishna-Balaram Mandir, Vrindavan
- cluster: Vrindavan/Braj/Mathura A route-sensitive
- type: internationally recognized modern Vrindavan temple/cultural institution
- importance: evident LP-level omission from an otherwise rich Braj list
- routing effect: local within Vrindavan; likely low incremental cost from fixed Vrindavan-proper sleep zone
- effect on cluster: no cluster-status change needed; additive visit candidate only.
- Mark decision: not yet separately graded in this integration.

### LP-GAP-03 — Bharat Kala Bhavan, BHU, Varanasi
- cluster: Varanasi/Sarnath A
- type: major museum / art / cultural collection
- importance: moderate-tier but legitimate omission, especially because BHU/south Varanasi can align with Assi-base routing
- routing effect: likely compatible with south-side day; needs exact routing only when dayplan is built
- effect on cluster: no status change.
- Mark decision: not yet separately graded in this integration.

## CCI CHECKLIST CLOSURES
- Kumaon nature coverage: sufficient; no evident major omission.
- Barabar/Nagarjuni: heavy Gaya discovery classification supported.
- Varanasi–Bodh Gaya corridor: no evident major missing nature/heritage stop.
- Mysore/Bengaluru: remains correctly C at cluster level.
- Magh Mela 2027: considered but NOT promoted because sources conflict on date/start relative to Mark travel window ending 2027-01-21. Calendar layer must resolve from authoritative 2027 schedule before any route consequence.

## NEXT DISCOVERY POLICY
No third full generic Lonely Planet sweep. Instead two bounded independent second-opinion workers are queued in:
`runs/active/INDIA8-LONELYPLANET-SECOND-OPINION-001/TASK.md`

Purpose: detect only additive micro-gems/nature outliers that the existing 80 + CCI-3 missed. Maximum 10 per worker; 0 valid. This is diminishing-return QA, not restart.

Date: 2026-08-20

Purpose: lossless accounting BEFORE physical-site deduplication and BEFORE any new Mark A/B/C round.

## HARD RULE
This ledger counts source-layer records/claims, not unique physical places. The same physical site can occur in multiple detectors, multiple persons and multiple scenes. No source record may disappear during deduplication: every record must later point either to a physical entity, an explicit duplicate mapping, a negative/non-presence control, or an unresolved queue item.
